WHAT WE DO

Your project.
One coordinated delivery.

Integrated construction solutions across civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and specialized works—from mobilization through handover.

OUR CORE CAPABILITIES

Civil & structural works

Excavation, foundations, reinforced concrete, masonry, and structural steel.

Architectural & finishing works

Interior and exterior finishes, partitions, ceilings, flooring, and facades.

MEP works

Electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and integrated building services.

Landscape & external works

Hardscape, softscape, infrastructure, and external development works.

ICT & low-current systems

Structured cabling, data networks, CCTV, access control, and communication systems.

Fire & life safety systems

Fire alarm, firefighting, and life-safety systems.

Smart building solutions

Building automation, controls, and integrated smart systems.

THE BLACK-C APPROACH

Plan with clarity.
Build with confidence.

Pre-construction

Successful projects begin long before construction starts. We establish the objectives, scope, budget, schedule, and constraints, working with clients and consultants to evaluate feasibility, identify risks, optimize costs, and develop a practical roadmap.

  • Site assessment & feasibility review
  • Budget development & cost planning
  • Project controls & scheduling
  • Value engineering
  • Constructability & technical reviews
  • Mock-ups & material evaluation
  • Long-lead procurement planning
  • Permitting & approval coordination

Construction management

We bring stakeholders, resources, schedules, and technical requirements together. Transparent communication, disciplined controls, proactive coordination, and real-time reporting support progress from mobilization through completion.

  • Stakeholder & multidisciplinary coordination
  • Shop drawing & material approval tracking
  • Site supervision & execution control
  • Subcontractor & vendor coordination
  • Progress meetings & action tracking
  • Quality inspections & testing

General contracting

One point of responsibility throughout construction. We coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, materials, site activities, and technical requirements in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project standards.

From mobilization through handover, we manage interfaces, resolve site challenges, monitor progress, and maintain control over quality, safety, schedule, and cost.

Client care

Our commitment continues beyond handover. We coordinate commissioning, documentation, outstanding works, warranty tracking, and closeout to support the transition from construction to operation.

  • Final inspections & deficiency closeout
  • Testing & commissioning coordination
  • Outstanding works & corrective-action tracking
  • Warranty tracking & follow-up
  • Permit & approval closeout coordination
  • Handover documentation & project closeout

Closeout documentation

  • As-built drawings
  • Testing & commissioning certificates
  • Equipment manuals & technical documentation
  • Warranty records
  • Operation & maintenance manuals
